description: Search published news coverage, newest first. Filter by brand, tagged product, publication date or text in titles, summaries and publisher names. Returns source reports, not verified release facts. Cite the publisher and preserve uncertainty. Uses the site's published dataset, not a live web search; updated_at is the last scan time. Use next_offset with the same filters for more results.

product.description: Exact release slug or partial product name, e.g. 'garmin-fenix-8-8s-8x' or 'fenix 8'. Matches tagged releases, not the whole family.

query.description: Case-insensitive text search; accents are ignored

since.description: Only items published on or after this date (UTC)

name: get_news

url.description: Source URL recorded by the feed; may be a Google News link

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null when exhausted

updated_at.description: Last scan time, not the time this query ran

title: Get news coverage
